messages:
Samir: Heads-up: noticed a weird overlap on the modal footer when a toast stack appears bottom-right. The primary/secondary button pair sits flush and the lowest toast overlaps the footer shadow. Screenshot attached.
Tess: Repro'd. Modal footer is using compact button spacing (btn-gap:8px) and footer padding got reduced to 12px for density. Toasts default to 16px from edge so they collide on 720px heights.
Rohan: Two paths: add a modal-bottom-safe token or make toasts aware of modal presence and increase bottom offset. I prefer token -> predictable.
kelly: Token sounds best. Maybe `modal-bottom-occupancy` that component sets when open. That way toast uses `max(--toast-default, var(--modal-bottom-occupancy))`. Keeps runtime simple.
Samir: Also note z-index: currently toasts are above modal which hides the footer action shadow. Should toasts go above or below modals? I think modals should always be top-level for actions.
Tess: Agreed: modal > toasts by default. Transient messages shouldn't obscure modal actions. Add token `toast-stack-z` with default below modal z.
Rohan: For accessibility: some modals show confirmation toasts that are icon-only (checkmark) which SRs miss. Require `role=alert` and visible text or `aria-label`. Also ensure focus isn't lost when a toast appears.
kelly: Implementation note: when modal opens set `--modal-bottom-occupancy: calc(var(--modal-padding-bottom,12px) + var(--modal-inset,8px))` and toasts compute `--toast-computed-offset: max(var(--toast-default,16px), var(--modal-bottom-occupancy,0px))`. That handles combos nicely.
design-bot: Suggested tokens snippet:
```
--toast-default: 16px
--modal-padding-bottom: 12px
--modal-inset: 8px
+ --modal-bottom-occupancy: calc(var(--modal-padding-bottom) + var(--modal-inset))
+ --toast-computed-offset: max(var(--toast-default), var(--modal-bottom-occupancy))
--toast-z: 900
+ --toast-z: 800 /* below modal z of 900 */
```
Samir: Also add a Storybook case: compact modal + FAB + 3 toasts to validate stacking and animation at 720px and 540px heights.
Tess: Docs copy: show example code for modal setting `data-modal-open='true'` and the CSS var example. Add a11y snippet: `role=alert` and `aria-label="Saved: draft updated"`.
Rohan: Quick dev checklist for PR: token added, z-index ordering updated, no visual overlap at narrow heights, animations respect resolved `--toast-computed-offset`, SR reads toast content, and focus remains on modal.
kelly: I'll prototype the CSS and add a tiny demo. Tagging reviewers after I push. :thumbsup:
